title: The Galois Correspondence for ℂ / ℝ

problemStatement.plain: Prove the Galois correspondence for C/R: intermediate fields correspond bijectively to subgroups of Gal(C/R), which is cyclic of order 2. Since a prime-order group has only two subgroups, there are no intermediate fields other than R and C. This is the Galois-theoretic alternative to the parent entry's tower-law proof.
whyMatters: Answers open question 3 of fundamental-theorem-algebra-oq-04 with a structurally different proof technique.

proven: every intermediate field is bot (R) or top (C)
knownResults.goal: Formalize the Galois correspondence and re-derive no-intermediate-fields from the subgroup lattice.
